notes: The 292 active claims include the dedicated 46, blob 30, identity 11 and London six; these audit subsets must not be added together as independent theorem totals.

The 36 main lists comprise 30 full execution matches, five independently matched admission refusals and one explicit native unsupported boundary. The 25 binding/comparator mutations and 16 local controls are separate counts.

The two local resource lists contain 512 reference transactions in total. The exact 16 MiB case also matches native execution; 16 MiB + 1 is an explicit native refusal at index 255, not a native execution match.

The 90 lexical cases contain 42 exact scanner refusals and 48 other controls; nine old/new spelling comparisons are additional invocations. Do not add the duplicate CI-only 90-case report as another distinct corpus.

The preserved parser crash report has exact input size/nesting/return code/stderr but does not itself contain binary SHA256 or process-limit metadata. Related pre-guard binary hashes are listed separately without asserting an intrinsic binding absent from that report.
Pre-guard spelling baselines are distinct from the older ordinary/blob binaries used for the completed unchanged-path timings. The timing report carries its own source commits and native hashes.

The ordinary retained report and 200-case blob-frame report do not embed their native SHA256. Their final guarded-run provenance is supplied by the final build/context; the hashes in nativeIdentities are independently present in the signed identity/blobhash and lexical reports.

Local dedicated audit reports retain requireHead=false and record the pre-publication HEAD. Their complete source pins were checked; published-HEAD binding is separately archived as a completed result, not inferred from local success.
The active source-consistency report says currentContractReplayChecked=false. It is evidence for the selected source closure, not replay of unrelated Ethereum contracts.

The 17 scanner claims establish scanner counter bounds and source-level continuation selection. They do not prove JSON grammar, compiler evaluation strategy or a general parser allocation bound. Error retention does not mean that the outer finite fold stops traversing bytes.

Signed differential claims use decoded Lean requests and complete synthetic witnesses, with host signature recovery and receipt/trie encoding. They do not establish authenticated header commitments, KZG sidecars, nonempty withdrawals, deployed beacon-root code, chain membership or full Ethereum conformance.

All underlying source, fixtures, checkers and workflows are reproducible from the published Git tree. This manifest maps existing scratch evidence into a suggested bundle; it does not copy or publish that evidence.

The exact-HEAD dedicated audit and full 146-pin HEAD comparison both completed after publication of 91cae62479cbd3a13775b3dd15f502646c11db41. Their artifacts are separate from the preserved local reports.
The separate default-CI JSON report repeats the same 90 guarded cases with no baseline invocations. It is included to reproduce the actual CI invocation and is not a further distinct corpus.

The pre-guard control report includes the minimal object and a non-crashing 100000-level document under the same development experiment. It is retained beside the 3000000-level crash, not counted as guarded coverage.

The 60-case retained ordinary transaction lane uses the unchanged evm-subset binary. The shared ordinary CLI is exercised by the 84-case signed identity suite, BLOBHASH ordinary cases, codec parity and lexical controls.

Timing records two unchanged process-inclusive CLI paths on the same host, not transaction-list throughput. Both median increases and observed tails are retained; no component attribution or speedup claim is made.

An independent read-only review compared the scanner with the pinned Lean JSON/Parsec implementation and all three callsites and found no concrete depth or exponent bypass. This is source review, not a parser-refinement or runtime memory-safety theorem.

The baseline observations were captured in this development session before codec extraction. Their original report does not embed a baseline native hash or source commit. The final guarded parity report separately identifies both compared current executables. The independent paired timing report binds its own retained predecessor builds to a published source; do not infer that metadata into this older capture.
